$comment: Parser §8 Mongo read-versus-write, from the method name. Motor/PyMongo collection methods. A method in neither list is emitted with `operation` omitted plus an unsupported_construct diagnostic (decision item 6). Receiver module markers are matched against dotted-name segments of what the receiver resolves to. Receiver roots are the names a Motor database handle is conventionally bound to; matching on them is why every datastore ref is `inferred`.
